description: Monthly Social Security retirement benefit if claimed at a given age between 62 and 70, from the full-retirement-age amount (PIA). Uses 5/9 of 1 percent a month for the first 36 early months, 5/12 of 1 percent after that, and 2/3 of 1 percent a month of delayed credits for people born after 1942, with SSA dime rounding.

birth_date.description: Birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "1960-07-15".

claim_age_years.description: Claiming age in whole years, 62 to 70.

pia.description: Monthly benefit at full retirement age (primary insurance amount) in dollars, from the SSA statement.

name: calculate_claiming_age_benefit
title: Calculate benefit by claiming age
